steps.title: Import Vue and useId from vue
steps.instruction: Import Vue and the useId composable from the 'vue' package.
steps.hint: Use the import statement to bring in Vue and useId from the vue module.
steps.analogousExample:
// Similar: importing from a package
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
steps.expectedOutcome: You'll have access to Vue's core functionality and the useId composable for generating stable IDs.
successCriteria: Vue and useId are imported from 'vue'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully imported Vue and useId. This gives you access to Vue's core features and the useId composable for generating stable IDs.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close! Make sure you're importing both Vue and useId from the 'vue' package.
steps.feedbackWrong: Let's try again. You need to import both Vue and the useId composable from the 'vue' package.

steps.title: Create the main Vue component
steps.instruction: Create a Vue component named 'StableIdDemo' using the `<script setup>` syntax and a `<template>` section. Return a simple `<div>` with the text 'Stable ID Demo' inside.
steps.hint: In Vue, you can create a component by writing `<script setup>` and `<template>` sections. The `<script setup>` enables Composition API features automatically.
steps.analogousExample: // Similar: a basic Vue component
steps.seedCode:
<script setup>
import { useId } from 'vue'
// Create your component here
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Add your template content here -->
</template>
steps.expectedOutcome: You will have a Vue component named 'StableIdDemo' with a `<script setup>` section and a template that renders a div containing 'Stable ID Demo'.
successCriteria: The component is defined with `<script setup>` and a `<template>` section, and the template renders a div with the text 'Stable ID Demo'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully created the main Vue component structure.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track. Make sure you have both `<script setup>` and `<template>` sections, and that the template renders a div with 'Stable ID Demo'.
steps.feedbackWrong: Let's try again. Create a Vue component with `<script setup>` and `<template>` that renders a div with 'Stable ID Demo'.

steps.title: Initialize useId for form fields
steps.instruction: Inside the script setup section, call the useId composable to generate a stable ID and store it in a constant named 'inputId'.
steps.hint: The useId composable returns a string ID. You can assign it to a constant like: const inputId = useId()
steps.analogousExample:
// Example: generating a stable ID
const myId = useId()
steps.seedCode:
<script setup>
import { useId } from 'vue'
// Call useId to generate a stable ID for form fields
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Add your template content here -->
</template>
steps.expectedOutcome: The useId composable is called and the generated ID is stored in a constant named 'inputId'.
successCriteria: The code contains 'const inputId = useId()' in the script setup section.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully generated a stable ID using Vue's useId composable.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're calling useId() and storing the result in a constant named 'inputId'.
steps.feedbackWrong: The step requires calling useId() and storing the result in a constant named 'inputId'. Please try again.

steps.hint: Create a regular JavaScript function that will be called when the form is submitted.

successCriteria: The handleSubmit function is defined and logs to the console when called.

steps.title: Add form container structure
steps.instruction: In the template section, add a <form> element that will contain your form fields. Give it an @submit.prevent event handler that calls your form submission handler.
steps.hint: Add a <form> tag inside the template. Use @submit.prevent to prevent the default form submission behavior and call your handler function.
steps.analogousExample:
<!-- Example: basic form structure -->
<form @submit.prevent="handleSubmit">
  <!-- Form fields will go here -->
</form>
steps.seedCode:
<script setup>
import { useId } from 'vue'
// Call useId to generate a stable ID for form fields

// Create reactive form data here

// Define form submission handler here
</script>

<template>
  <form @submit.prevent="handleSubmit">
    <!-- Form fields will go here -->
  </form>
</template>
steps.expectedOutcome: A form element is added to the template with proper event handling for submission.
successCriteria: The template contains a <form> element with @submit.prevent="handleSubmit" attribute.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've added the form container with proper event handling. The @submit.prevent will call your handler when the form is submitted.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added a form element, but make sure it has the @submit.prevent attribute pointing to your handler function.
steps.feedbackWrong: The form element is missing or doesn't have the correct event handler. Add a <form> tag with @submit.prevent="handleSubmit".

steps.title: Add name input field with stable ID
steps.instruction: Inside the form, add a text input field for the name with v-model binding to the reactive data and use the generated stable ID for the 'id' attribute.
steps.hint: Use the generated ID from useId for the input's id attribute and bind the input value to the reactive form data using v-model.
steps.analogousExample:
// Example: input field with stable ID and v-model
<input type="text" :id="nameId" v-model="formData.name" placeholder="Enter your name">
steps.seedCode:
<script setup>
import { useId } from 'vue'
// Call useId to generate a stable ID for form fields
const nameId = useId()

// Create reactive form data here
const formData = {
  name: ''
}

// Define form submission handler here
const handleSubmit = () => {
  console.log('Form submitted:', formData)
}
</script>

<template>
  <form @submit.prevent="handleSubmit">
    <!-- Add name input field here -->
  </form>
</template>
steps.expectedOutcome: The form will have a text input field for the name, bound to the reactive data and using the stable ID from useId.
successCriteria: The input field has :id="nameId", v-model="formData.name", and is placed inside the form.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully added a name input field with a stable ID and v-model binding.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added an input field, but make sure it has both :id="nameId" and v-model="formData.name" attributes.
steps.feedbackWrong: The input field is missing or doesn't have the required attributes. Check that you've used :id="nameId" and v-model="formData.name".
